extractions.value: Patient had severe rheumatoid arthritis and had been on penicillamine for a decade prior to onset. Clinical course described as waxing and waning rigidity. A left quadriceps muscle biopsy demonstrated angular and fascicular atrophy suggesting denervation and vascular or fascial inflammation associated with RA.
extractions.quote: Our patient's clinical course of waxing and waning rigidity discounts tetanus but strongly supports an SMS-PEMWRS continuum.
